name: 49337 · Newaygo, MI
findings: ZIP 49337 (Newaygo) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49337 (Newaygo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
